cross_component_interfaces.contract: Cross-language TX-V2 signing and TX-ID encoding contract between Rust wallet and TypeScript L1 protocol primitives. Field order, fixed widths, optional recipient tags, PoH hash and domain separation must be byte-identical.
cross_component_interfaces.status_reason: TypeScript canonicalTransactionId derives an ID without enforcing the same chain_id/tx_type/PoH-length preconditions as canonicalSigningPreimage; Rust/TypeScript golden vectors and invalid-input semantics are not yet proven.

request_schema.notes: The signing preimage validates chain_id, tx_type, sender and PoH hash length; the ID derivation path currently bypasses some of these checks.

response_schema.format: byte preimage or 32-byte SHA-256 TX ID
response_schema.notes: Cross-language golden vectors must establish exact byte equality and consistent invalid-input handling.

error_timeout_semantics.partial_failure_behavior: No state mutation occurs in these pure encoding functions.

authorization_capability.trust_boundary: Pure protocol encoding functions; callers remain responsible for transaction admission and signature authorization.
authorization_capability.fail_closed_rule: Invalid transaction fields must be rejected before a canonical TX ID is used for admission.

compatibility.policy: TX-V2 and TX-ID-V2 only; cross-language byte layout and input-validation semantics must be normatively consistent.

cross_component_interfaces.resolution_rule: Remain BLOCKED until invalid-input semantics are explicitly approved, Rust and TypeScript functions are source-mapped at exact SHAs, and cross-language golden/negative vectors pass.

release_decision.reason: This catalog establishes ownership and measurable function-level acceptance criteria. Component production readiness remains unverified until source-specific implementation, exact-SHA gates, interface conformance and required security/operational evidence are attached.
forbidden_shortcuts: archive or delete source repositories based on catalog alone

scope.rule: The exact-HEAD census covers all 26 active repositories locally (2026-10-14 replica, manifest-pinned expected full SHAs); one private active repository is locally accessible but remains CI-excluded for missing CI credentials; seven archived repositories are reference-only. 3,926 runtime source symbol candidates remain unbound after 7,399 reasoned policy exclusions (binding backlog, org-wide, not ShivaCore). 0 line-keyed duplicate source bindings; 123 symbol-name collision groups across impl blocks are tracked informationally. No lexical source match is functional verification.

source_symbol_reconciliation.next_gate: Reconcile the 10,815 remaining unbound candidates into function contracts or individually justified exclusions; prioritize canonical GlobusOS/ShivaCore, A-TownChain, ATC-VM and ATCLang surfaces.
